int solve(int n, int k, int s, long long t) {
    while (t % n != 0) {
        int delta = (s < k ? 1 : -1) * (t % n);
        s = (s + n + delta) % n;
        t--;
    }

    t /= n;

    vector<long long> when(n, -1);

    for (long long left = t; left > 0; left--) {
        if (when[s] != -1) {
            long long period = when[s] - left;

            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (when[i] != -1 && when[i] <= when[s] && when[i] % period == 0) {
                    return i;
                }
            }

            throw 1;
        }
        when[s] = left;

        for (int i = n - 1; i > 0; i--) {
            if (s < k) {
                s += i;
                if (s >= n) {

                }
            } else {
                s -= i;
                if (s < 0) {

            }
        }
    }

    return s;
}

int maxDepth(const vector<int>& p) {

            used[v] = i;
            cur++;
            v = p[v];

        ret = max(ret, cur);
